caption:
The day after Saturday's game, Lulu aches all over. Tackles, rucks and scrums leave the legs feeling like concrete.

Recovery is usually a mix, not one thing. Remedial massage can help ease tight muscles, and it tends to help most alongside good sleep and gentle movement. Fresh injuries are worth checking before any massage.

Hybi's recovery plan: an easy 10 to 15 minute walk or bike the next day, sleep and fluids, and a quad stretch for 30 seconds, twice each leg.

After any head knock with headache or dizziness, see a doctor first. Our remedial massage therapists at Hybrid Physio can help. Book online via the link in bio

General information only — not a substitute for an individual assessment.
